digest_md:
- **Ipswich** ⚠️ *Ipswich not in 2026/27 list? — it is listed.* Maeda (fwd, ex-Celtic) signs — new attacking option to watch.
- **Newcastle**: £34m Bamba (Monaco) incoming; also closing on Liverpool forward Kiernan — squad depth, minutes uncertain early.
- **Chelsea**: sign defender Lacroix from Palace — bolsters backline; also chasing Villa set-piece coach MacPhee (marginal set-piece threat boost).
- **Crystal Palace**: lose Lacroix (defensive downgrade); eyeing Brest teen Le Guen.
- **Man Utd**: add Leicester keeper Leitzig — likely backup, no starter implications.
- **Spurs**: captain Romero linked to Inter — monitor; defensive uncertainty if he departs.
- **Nott'm Forest**: linked with £116m-era Elliot Anderson move — potential midfield addition to track.
